submission.natural_language_explanation: This direction fires retrospectively at subject-predicate agreement slots: on the number/person inflection of a finite verb (or agreeing participle/adjective), or on the subject nominal that fixes those features, once an overt controller subject is present, in any language. The same words without a finite agreeing predicate (participles, infinitives, imperatives, verbless fragments) go quiet.
